item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Suede Videos
item.description:
Hi there,

I was wondering if anyone had any Suede video that they'd be willing to share There's some stuff circulating that I don't have yet, like the 1992 Manchester gig, Dublin 1996, and the HD version of Latitude 2011. I've got a good amount of Suede stuff myself to trade - InRocks 2013, Mercury Prize Sessions 2013, full Glastonbury 2003 and 2015 sets, Virgin Radio Sunset Sessions 2025 Live Stream, etc. I also have an extensive collection of Suede audio (inc;. my own uncirculated tapes) if anyone's interested.
